# Solana MEV RPC Paywall

Base URL: https://solana-mev-rpc-paywall.vercel.app

Solana mainnet RPC relay, Jito telemetry, and Jupiter arbitrage quote feeds.

## Discovery

- Sales and current treasury: GET https://solana-mev-rpc-paywall.vercel.app/api/sales
- Payment metadata: https://solana-mev-rpc-paywall.vercel.app/.well-known/x402.json
- API specification: https://solana-mev-rpc-paywall.vercel.app/openapi.json
- MCP JSON-RPC endpoint: POST https://solana-mev-rpc-paywall.vercel.app/api/mcp

## Prices

- 0.005 SOL (5000000 lamports): POST /api/rpc/relay, /api/mev/jito-tip, /api/mev/block-prep.
- 0.05 SOL (50000000 lamports): GET /api/arb/spreads and /api/arb/triangular; POST /api/credits/mint gives 50 prepaid calls.
- USDC equivalents: 0.50 USDC per micro call and 5 USDC per high-throughput call or credit bundle.
- MCP initialize and tools/list are free; tools/call costs the corresponding tool price.

## Payment

Settlement is native SOL via a system-program lamport transfer or USDC via a treasury-owned token account. The SOL/wSOL mint identifier is So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112; native settlement is not an SPL wrapped-SOL transfer. The USDC mint is EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v. The network is solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp.

The service uses custom native-sol-finalized-v1 and usdc-finalized-v1 schemes with x402-v2-style envelopes, not the standard x402 exact scheme. Standard clients need a custom adapter. Request a 402 challenge, pay its recipient with the exact memo, and send the signature and challenge secret, or a signed base64 transaction and secret for broadcast. Retry a pending signature after finalization. Never disclose the challenge secret. Alternatively send a prepaid key in X-API-CREDIT-KEY. Payments and credits are consumed before execution; upstream failures do not automatically refund.
